svg.title: Phase 1 architecture — in-process exception, three request shapes
svg.desc: Phase 1 of the RDK Dispatcher: read-only triage discovery, real command execution, and toolset.push, all running through Dispatch Core's single ACL checkpoint. Per add-phase1-command-execution-exception (2026-08-14), the command-execution toolset runs in-process as a tracked, time-bounded exception to the project's general out-of-process/sandboxed rule; the Triage Toolset is treated the same way for Phase 1 under a documented assumption pending formal reconciliation. No sandboxing, no payload encryption, and no on-demand process spawning are part of Phase 1 -- all deferred to Phase 2.
svg.text: Phase 1 Architecture — in-process exception (A15)
Blue = Shape A (read-only discovery) · Green = Shape B (real command execution) · Red = Shape C (toolset.push)

Command-Execution Toolset(s)

IN-PROCESS — explicit, tracked exception (A15)
hardening to out-of-process/sandboxed: Phase 2
toolset.push handler (inside Dispatch Core)
dedicated ACL scope · inline signature/manifest verification · RDM boundary check (A6, unchanged)
health-check-gated in-process swap (P1-10) — NOT the artifact-fallback model (that's Phase 2)
RDM Client (existing, unchanged)
Only exercised if a Phase 1 toolset needs a dlopen()-able binary — otherwise idle this phase
What's deliberately absent from this diagram
1. No sandbox boxes (namespaces, seccomp, cgroups) -- FR-13/FR-14 deferred to Phase 2 for every
toolset shown here, per the tracked exception (A15).
2. No payload decryption step inside Dispatch Core -- Phase 1 payloads are plain JSON-RPC, only
signature/manifest-verified, per A7's unchanged phasing.
3. No spawn/idle-timeout logic -- A8's on-demand execution model applies once Phase 2 hardens
these toolsets to run out-of-process; nothing to spawn while they're in-process.
4. No Platform Adapters (RBUS/Thunder/CLI) -- out of Phase 1's scope entirely.
5. SAT token validation is shown as a step but its logic is blocked pending A1's confirmation --
this is the single most consequential open item for actually building this diagram's flows.
6. The Triage Toolset's in-process placement here is a documented assumption (§0 of docs/22),
not a re-confirmed decision -- pending formal reconciliation.
